  -- Observation: Search results included Wikipedia and biographypot.com, both stating "Naha, Okinawa, Japan".
  -- Thought: Multiple sources confirm the birthplace; need to extract and cite.

  -- Thought: Britannica does not have a Namie Amuro entry; need alternative sources.
  -- Result: Reported failure to find Britannica page.

  -- Thought: Wikipedia and IMDb are reliable; can use them to confirm birthplace.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to visit Wikipedia and IMDb pages.

  -- Observation: Wikipedia infobox states "Born: September 20, 1977, Naha, Okinawa, Japan".
  -- Thought: Confirmed birthplace from a reliable source.

  -- Observation: IMDb states "Born: September 20, 1977 · Naha, Japan" (missing Okinawa in snippet).
  -- Thought: IMDb confirms Naha, Japan; Wikipedia provides more detail (Okinawa).
